item.title: axios 0.35.0 (npm) — breaking/deprecated wording
item.description: Quote: ## ⚠️ Breaking Changes & Deprecations - **Parameter Depth Limit:** `params` nested deeper than 100 levels now reject with `ERR_BAD_OPTION_VALUE`. (**#11243**) Quote: …ts, and the configured agent's `destroy()` also cleans up its direct pool. Cached direct pools stay selected after public proxy options are removed or replaced. (**#11243**)… Quote: …unwrapped, sparse arrays are preserved, and non-canonical numeric field names survive JSON serialization. Inherited read-only numeric slots no longer block conversion or multipart serialization. (**#11243**)… Release notes: https://github.com/axios/axios/releases/tag/v0.35.0
